scenicChapters.title: Storen-Wildsberg → Egelsee
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 35 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: For 38 km this is Grand Tour of Switzerland, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

places-storen-wildsberg-riesi.story: From Greifensee it runs 286 km to Greifensee; allow about 4 h 56 of riding. It goes by way of Egelsee, Robenhausen, Riedmatt and Riesi. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
